title: How Different, or Different How? Stance Granularity in Viewpoint Selection for Dialog Systems that Engage Users with Alternative Views
abstract: arXiv:2610.31459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. translated_title: 差异多大，还是如何差异？让用户接触替代观点的对话系统中观点选择的立场粒度问题
translated_abstract: 旨在帮助用户接触与自己不同观点的系统，必须决定这些观点应当有多不同。目前观点主要以标量尺度表示，这种表示过于粗糙，无法区分那些在与用户不同的方面上存在分歧的观点。我们提出了一种选择策略：由多臂老虎机设定观点与用户之间允许的距离，策略在该界限内选择最新颖的观点。我们仅改变其中的立场编码器，将标量分数与“视角化立场向量”进行比较，后者将一个立场分解为针对各个概念的独立立场。我们将其集成到一个对话系统中，并开展了一项被试间实验（N=63）。结果表明，概念层面的立场能够带来更多样化的接触序列和更广泛的话题立场覆盖范围，但并未改变用户论证观点的深度或重构观点的准确性。最后，我们在概念层面分析了用户与观点之间的关系，展示……
tldr: 本文提出一种由多臂老虎机驱动的观点选择策略，将立场表示从标量分数细化为概念层面的“视角化立场向量”，发现概念级立场能让用户接触到更多样、覆盖更广的观点，但不会改变用户论证和重构观点的深度与准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bandit-based viewpoint selection policy that refines stance representation from a scalar score to concept-level Perspectivized Stance Vectors, showing that concept-level stance yields more varied and broader viewpoint exposure for users without affecting how deeply they justify or accurately reconstruct those viewpoints.
